definitions.explanation: An electric device that produces light, typically consisting of a glass bulb containing a filament or LED.

examples.japanese: {電球|でんきゅう}が{切|き}れたので{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: The light bulb burned out, so I replaced it.

examples.japanese: LED{電球|でんきゅう}は{長持|ながも}ちする。
examples.english: LED bulbs last a long time.

examples.japanese: {電球|でんきゅう}を{買|か}いに{行|い}かなければ。
examples.english: I need to go buy a light bulb.

examples.japanese: {台所|だいどころ}の{電球|でんきゅう}を{換|か}えてくれる？
examples.english: Can you change the light bulb in the kitchen?

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{電球|でんきゅう}をLED{電球|でんきゅう}に{取|と}り{替|か}えたら、{電気代|でんきだい}が{安|やす}くなった。
examples.english: After replacing the old light bulbs with LED bulbs, the electricity bill went down.

notes:
COMPOUND: {電|でん} (electricity) + {球|きゅう} (ball, bulb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電球|でんきゅう}が{切|き}れる (light bulb burns out)
- {電球|でんきゅう}を{換|か}える/{交換|こうかん}する (change/replace a bulb)
- {電球|でんきゅう}をつける (turn on the light)
- LED{電球|でんきゅう} (LED bulb)
- {蛍光|けいこう}{灯|とう} (fluorescent light)

RELATED TERMS:
- {電気|でんき} (electricity, electric light)
- ランプ (lamp)
- {照明|しょうめい} (lighting, illumination)
